remarks: Marina Bay waterfront living at its best! Two bedroom, two and a half bath townhouse style unit with a great layout. The main level invites an open feeling. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances, new quartz counters and backsplash. The living room hosts a wood burning fireplace. The dining area has sliders to a private balcony. The primary bedroom is located on the upper level with en-suite bath, walk in closet and sliders to your private balcony. Plenty of storage throughout and full sized, in unit washer and dryer. Some recent updates include new HVAC, LED lighting and outfitted closets. There's so much to love about Marina Bay in Shippan! Relax by the pool, watch the boats come and go and enjoy the rising or setting sun over the harbor. This is the good life!
